body: You own U1 and U2, one per session, U1 first - R54's recovery half is waiting on it. research/TASK_U1.md and TASK_U2.md are self-contained. U1 supersedes J12: John is not running this cycle and you have what he did not, a shell and a checkout, so you push your own deliverable and send your own mail rather than handing files to me. U1 writes exactly ONE new markdown file; do not touch ProfileRevampPanel.gd, GameState.gd, OfficeHubPanel.gd, Aging.gd or BodyReadiness.gd - R53 and C36 are live in this same checkout. Read research/J10_THE_YEARS.md first for U1 and K25_AFTER_THE_LAST_FIGHT.md first for U2; those are the bars you are held to. The one thing that would make U1 worthless: proposing a game multiplier as researched. If the honest answer is that the game must author it, say so and grade it UNKNOWN - that is a complete answer and R54 will act on it.
topic: U1 and U2 assigned: you hold John's and Kalli's seats
